reader_question: How many jobs did the economy add each month?
grade_line: Documented: a Bureau of Labor Statistics survey of employers, as copied by FRED
title: The three-month average of monthly job change stood at 51,000 in September 2026, a preliminary figure, and payrolls shrank in seven of the 57 months charted.
measure_line: Monthly change in payroll jobs, all nonfarm, seasonally adjusted, United States, January 2022 to September 2026, the span both jobs charts share, with the three-month average. Columns start at zero.
notes: The three-month average for a month is the mean of that month’s change and the two before it, so the averages for January and February 2022 draw on November and December 2021, months the chart does not show.
Seasonally adjusted: the Bureau removes the swings that recur each year, such as summer hiring and holiday layoffs, so one month compares with the next.

August and September 2026 are preliminary: the Bureau of Labor Statistics revises each month’s first estimate in the next two monthly reports, and a yearly benchmark revision can move earlier months. The average is dashed where it includes a preliminary month.
Payrolls shrank in seven months: January, June, August, October and December 2025, and February and July 2026.
Both jobs charts run from January 2022 to September 2026, so they hold three full years before the January 2025 inauguration and every month since.
source_line: Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Current Employment Statistics, all nonfarm employees, monthly change, seasonally adjusted, January 2022 to September 2026, United States, via FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis. Retrieved November 6, 2026. August and September 2026 are preliminary and will be revised.
alt: Columns show the monthly change in payroll jobs from January 2022 to September 2026: large gains in 2022, up to 819,000 in February, that shrink to under 200,000 a month by 2025, with seven months of losses in 2025 and 2026. A line shows the three-month average, which stood at 51,000 in September 2026, a preliminary figure.

table.caption: Monthly change in payroll jobs and its three-month average

chart_notes: Key: a gray column is the jobs added or lost in the month; hatched columns are preliminary, August and September 2026.
Three-month average: the heavy line, dashed where it includes a preliminary month.

labels.key_columns: Jobs added or lost in the month
